tasks.name: sum_acc
tasks.working: SnaxShell: the counter is reset by the accepted start and counts each busy cycle; busy rises the cycle after the start. Pipelined, L 1, II 1, drain 0, inputs always valid and the output always ready: firing k (from 0) in busy cycle 1 + 1 * k, the last (7) in 8, its result pushed 1 later, the run's last cycle (a sum before it leaves while the next input is taken): 9 busy cycles
